title: NewtonCollisionAPI (contact offset fallbacks)
summary: Newton contact margin and gap, read for every collider as fallbacks for the PhysX rest and contact offsets when those are absent.
producer_scope: Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the ovphysx Newton schema notes).

columns.name: newton:contactMargin
columns.absent: No override: the PhysX rest offset stands.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). Read for every collider without checking usd-schemas; when physxCollision:restOffset is absent a value >= 0 becomes the rest offset.

columns.name: newton:contactGap
columns.absent: No override: the PhysX contact offset stands.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). Read for every collider without checking usd-schemas; when physxCollision:contactOffset is absent a finite value >= 0 sets the contact offset to margin + gap (-inf, USD's fallback, means use the default). The pair is then bumped so the contact offset exceeds the rest offset.

notes: The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonCollisionAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonCollisionAPI makes the cache bypass.

Newton's schema makes PhysicsCollisionAPI built-ins of this API, and USD population lists built-ins among a prim's applied schemas. The builder writes only what the caller applies, so it requires them on the same prim instead of writing a prim the walker would not recognize.
